This template is used to cite or otherwise list the original home video releases of the prequel trilogy, sequel trilogy, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', and the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]. It accepts 1-3, 7-9, TCW, Rogue One, or Solo as parameters, and will generate links to both the film and the [[Star Wars home video releases]] article; this is templated as {{U|C4-DE Bot}} doesn't play well with double links on the same line.

<code><nowiki>{{FilmVideo|1}}</nowiki></code>

results in:

{{FilmVideo|1}}
